0022600139.text: The Warriors (1-3) are 4th in the Pacific and 12th in the West, currently on a one-game winning streak, while the Timberwolves (3-1) are 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West, coming off a loss. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), and Yaxel Lendeborg is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision, having averaged 21.8 points and 33.4 minutes this season. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. In 2025-26 the Warriors lost the season series 1-3, including a 127-117 loss in San Francisco on March 13, 2026.
